warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport P290 Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: If your Discovery Sport P290 has the Ingenium AJ200P (L663 generation):
Timing chain wear — Ingenium diesel engines share a well-documented timing chain pattern. We replace timing chains, guides and tensioners as standard on every Ingenium AJ200P rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established specialist consensus, l663.guide specialist buying guide, what-breaks.com. This applies to L663 Defenders only — not to classic Defender models
